wget -q https://go.dev/dl/go1.23.0.linux-amd64.tar.gz && tar -C /usr/local -xzf go1.23.0.linux-amd64.tar.gz && go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@latest
curl -sSfL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/golangci/golangci-lint/master/install.sh | sh -s -- -b $(go env GOPATH)/bin v1.61.0 && go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@latest
python3 -c 'import sys; print(sys.version)' && go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@latest
node -e 'console.log(1)' && go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@latest
cp -r templates/ out/ && go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@latest
rsync -a src/ dst/ && go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@latest
mkdir -p ~/bin && cp tool ~/bin/ && go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@latest

echo hi > out.txt && go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@latest
go mod download && go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@latest
make && go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@latest
